messages:
Faye Sato: Hi everyone! I9m Faye, joining Platform Runtime from a small solar-tech startup in Osaka. Excited to work on latency/batching. I also make elaborate bento boxes and plan to bring one on Tuesday. :bento: :sun_with_face:
Mira Patel: welcome Faye!! :tada: we9re obsessed with bento art here. which day are you in?
Faye Sato: Tuesdays and Thursdays for the next couple weeks. mornings are best for me. might bring matcha cookies too. :cookie:
Noah Kim: welcome! excited for the bento reveal. also we have a very needy succulent in the kitchen if you want to adopt it temporarily. :seedling: :laughing:
Rajesh Bhaskar: hey Faye, welcome aboard. if you9re free, join the 9:30 infra sync on Tuesday — we grab coffee after. Blue Chair is the usual. :coffee:
Faye Sato: thanks Rajesh, I9ll be there. I9ll bring a tiny solar-powered phone charger as a silly icebreaker. :battery:
Mira Patel: that9s peak onboarding energy. also FYI sticker shelf by reception if you want to decorate your laptop. :sparkles:
Devex Bot: Welcome message posted to #new-hires and added Faye to the Team Lunch reminder.
Noah Kim: quick poll: sushi :sushi:, biryani :rice_ball:, or ramen :ramen:? react with emoji to vote.
Faye Sato: :sushi: but happy to follow the group.
Rajesh Bhaskar: :ramen: from me.
Mira Patel: :sushi:
Noah Kim: tally so far — sushi 2, ramen 1. sushi looks likely.
Faye Sato: perfect, see you Tuesday! I9ll bring an origami sun with the bento for whoever wants it. :sun_with_face: :smile:
Mira Patel: welcome again 10 excited to have you on infra/perf! :raised_hands:
